diff --git a/mailnews/intl/moz.build b/mailnews/intl/moz.build
index 0f2a310a0ff..59dcab1dfb5 100644
--- a/mailnews/intl/moz.build
+++ b/mailnews/intl/moz.build
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@ GENERATED_FILES += [
     "charsetalias.properties.h",
 ]
 charsetalias = GENERATED_FILES["charsetalias.properties.h"]
-charsetalias.script = "/intl/locale/props2arrays.py"
+charsetalias.script = "props2arrays.py"
 charsetalias.inputs = ["charsetalias.properties"]
 
 FINAL_LIBRARY = "mail"
diff --git a/mailnews/intl/props2arrays.py b/mailnews/intl/props2arrays.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..abc6e2a3e8a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mailnews/intl/props2arrays.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+
+
+def main(header, propFile):
+    mappings = {}
+
+    with open(propFile) as f:
+        for line in f:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line.startswith("#"):
+                parts = line.split("=", 1)
+                if len(parts) == 2 and len(parts[0]) > 0:
+                    mappings[parts[0].strip()] = parts[1].strip()
+
+    keys = mappings.keys()
+
+    header.write("// This is a generated file. Please do not edit.\n")
+    header.write("// Please edit the corresponding .properties file instead.\n")
+
+    entries = [
+        '{ "%s", "%s", %d }' % (key, mappings[key], len(mappings[key]))
+        for key in sorted(keys)
+    ]
+    header.write(",\n".join(entries) + "\n")
+
